scope: B15 authentication, tenant session, export/audit, erasure, XSS, keyboard, zoom, and PWA proof

assertions.name: only the valid unused recovery token changes the password
same-user session remains tenant-scoped and cannot read another organization
another valid user session cannot erase a worker outside its organization
stored adversarial text persists as data for browser escaping proof
deletion, write-off, and settings mutations retain actor org record context and before-after payloads
expired recovery token is rejected after its configured lifetime
atomic worker erasure removes intended PII while preserving production and payroll basis
erasure audit preserves actor org action record context without retained worker PII
owner data export is audited before browser download
browser proof completed executable XSS, keyboard, zoom, session, and export checks and records the PWA install blocker
